hero.title: Let's build your website together
hero.body: I help people build their websites by carefully listening to their needs and picking tools that get the job done.

howIWork.title: How we iterate, while making sure we're building the right thing.

steps.title: Figure out why
steps.body: We start by understanding with why you need a website, and what you are trying to achieve right now. That way we make sure your website is aligned with your business.

steps.title: Find a style you like
steps.body: We create mock-ups with AI and iterate on them together until we land on aesthetics that genuinely feel like you.

steps.title: Design the content
steps.body: We shape the pages, the content, and the templates you need — for your courses, your products, or your offering.

steps.title: Break it into components
steps.body: We break the pages into components that articulate your message and your values in the style we chose.

steps.title: Make it yours to edit
steps.body: We iterate, then turn the prototype into a real site you can update yourself while the style stays sharp.

about.title: A curious blend between Software Engineering and Relational Attunement.
paragraphs: I was a software engineer for 10 years, working in video games and other tech-heavy fields. In the past 10 years I have been interested in entrepreneurship, relationasl practices, coaching and therapy. I trained in somatic therapy, practiced many forms of mindfulness and developed a keen ability for attunement. Along the way I kept exploring how websites get built.
I'm happy to sit with you in the language of your practice, and be your ally in working with technology.

contact.title: I'd love to learn more about you and what you want your site to do
contact.body: I'm looking for collaborations. Tell me about your vision for your website and your business needs, and let's work out the right tools for you.
